snippet.title: Mind Inc - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Try out our new Demo on Steam for free.

Mind Inc is a puzzle adventure inside the labyrinth of the mind. Gather scattered pieces of thought and restore forgotten memories.

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3797990/Mind_Inc/
